Perry, Georgia }} '''Al Thornton''' (born [[December 7]], [[1983]] in [[Perry, Georgia]]), is an American professional [[basketball]] player, most recently a college player for the [[Florida State Seminoles]]. He is a projected late lottery pick in the [[2007 NBA Draft]]. ==College== Al Thornton's outstanding four-year career at Florida State University was capped off by a stellar individual senior year that saw him make the AP All-American 3rd team, a unanimous selection to the All-ACC 1st team and was runner up to Boston College's [[Jared Dudley]] for the ACC player of the year. He led the ACC in scoring and averaged over 7 rebounds a contest as well. His season came to a disappointing end as the Seminoles were snubbed from the NCAA tournament for the second straight season, and forced to play in the NIT. Thornton's team did not make the tournament in his 4 years there despite his stellar individual play.http://seminoles.cstv.com/sports/m-baskbl/mtt/thornton_al00.html Jumped and dunked over Wisconsin's 7 foot Center Greg Steitsma in a game in the ACC-Big 10 Challenge. http://youtube.com/watch?v=WBBBw3OoFrQ ==Personal== *Born Dec. 7, 1983 *Al is the son of Alford and Philomenia Thornton ... comes from a tall family ... his dad stands 6-foot-6 and three sisters are all nearly 6-foot tall *His height in college was listed as 6-8, but NBA measurements showed that his true height is 6-5.75 and that even in shoes he is only 6-7 *selected Florida State over Cincinnati, Kentucky and [[Georgia Bulldogs|Georgia]]. ==Notes== ==External links== *[http://seminoles.cstv.com/sports/m-baskbl/mtt/thornton_al00.html FSU Player Profile] *[http://www.draftexpress.com/viewprofile.php?p=591 Draft Express Profile] *[http://sports.espn.go.com/ncb/player/profile?playerId=15564 ESPN Player Profile] *[http://nbadraft.net/admincp/profiles/althornton.html NBADraft.net Profile] {{DEFAULTSORT:Thornton, Al}} [[Category:1983 births]] [[Category:Living people]] [[Category:People from Georgia (U.S. state)]] [[Category:American basketball players]] [[Category:African American basketball players]] [[Category:Florida State Seminoles men's basketball players]] [[Category:Small forwards]] {{Persondata |NAME=Thornton, Al |SHORT DESCRIPTION=College Basketball Player, 2007 NBA Draft Prospect |DATE OF BIRTH=[[December 7]], [1983] |PLACE OF BIRTH=[[Perry, Georgia]] |DATE OF DEATH= |PLACE OF DEATH= }}
